verdict.rationale: Column is itself the nationally chartered bank, and its stack was built from scratch, so the API sits directly on the bank's own core rather than a middleware ledger (column-probe-1, column-comm-3). It also documents reconciliation-grade reporting: bank_account_transaction and bank_account_summary reports in CSV/JSON/Parquet, plus monthly statements (column-docs-8, column-docs-21). However, no evidence describes an explicit daily reconciliation process or attestation between API-reported balances and bank-held funds. Missing for 10: documented daily reconciliation process, explicit API-to-core ledger parity guarantee, FBO sub-ledger reconciliation documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
